description.value: The Clearbrook Library is a community branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library system, the largest public library network in British Columbia, serving Abbotsford's Clearbrook neighbourhood since 1995. As part of a 25-branch system reaching over 800,000 residents, it offers books, digital resources, public computers, and a range of community programs. For a touring cyclist moving through Abbotsford, it provides a welcoming, publicly accessible rest stop with washrooms and free Wi-Fi.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific Clearbrook Library branch page in OSM (https://www.fvrl.bc.ca/locations/clearbrook_library.php) returned a 404 Page Not Found error, so branch-specific amenity confirmation relies primarily on OSM tags; OSM confirms toilets=yes (washrooms) and internet_access=wlan (Wi-Fi). The FVRL /locations subpage lists 'bike_dock Outdoor Bike Racks' as a system-wide feature icon in what appears to be a legend for all branches, but without the Clearbrook-specific page loading, this cannot be confirmed for this branch. The FVRL website overall is operational, and nothing indicates the Clearbrook branch is closed.
concerns: The OSM website URL (https://www.fvrl.bc.ca/locations/clearbrook_library.php) returns a 404 Page Not Found error; the branch-specific page URL appears outdated or reorganized. The main FVRL website is operational. The correct current URL for this branch should be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible public library branch in active operation; confirmed washrooms and Wi-Fi make it a useful rest stop for touring cyclists passing through Abbotsford.
